refsect1.title: BUGS
refsect1.para: After something gets installed or removed from the @INSTALLCONFIGDIR@ or @LOCALCONFIGDIR@ there's a brief delay before the change takes effect. This is because some package managers remove a file before putting an updated version there. If vera manages to rescan the directory the missing unit file gets processed as a removed container and the unit gets stopped. A debounce delay of several seconds must pass before the configuration directory gets rescanned.
The debounce delay may be insufficient on a very loaded system. Do not install or update vera or any packages that ship unit configuration files if the system is very loaded.
